headline: Elected Betsy Houde as chairperson for the coming year and approved March 2026 minutes.
summary: Nicole Jamieson shared thank-you letters from last year's grant recipients. The application will be released on December 7, 2026, and is due Monday, January 11, 2027, by 5:00pm. Committee meetings start the week of January 20, 2027.
decisions: Approved the minutes from March 17, 2026, unanimously.
Elected Betsy Houde as chairperson for the coming year, unanimously.

plain_text:
Citizens Advisory Commission 
November 9, 2028 
Minutes 
 
 
 
Called to order at 6:31pm by Jason Telerski, FY2027 chairperson 
 
Present: 
Jason Telerski 
Alderman Derek Thibeault 
Oscar Villacis 
Jennifer Bishop 
Betsy Houde 
City Admin: Nicole Jamieson 
 
Nicole shared several thank you letters from last year’s grant recipients. 
 
 
Minutes from March 17, 2026 were approved unanimously. Motion made by JB seconded by 
OV.  
 
Application will be released on December 7, 2026 and will be due on Monday, January 11, 2027 
by 5:00pm. 
 
Committee meetings will start the week of Wednesday, January 20, 2027 with a start time of 
6:00pm to 8:00pm. Nicole will schedule us out through March 17, 2027. 
 
Election of chair: Jason Telerski nominated Betsy Houde (Elizabeth G. Houde) to serve as 
chairperson for the coming year. Seconded by Jennifer Bishop. Unanimously approved.  
 
Jen made a motion to end the meeting. Jason seconded. All approved.
